capabilities: Maintain a contact database in one portable Markdown table file
Insert @mentions via autocomplete triggered by a configurable character
Render mentions as linked, highlighted contact names with hover cards
Find every note that mentions a contact
Rename a mention key and rewrite matching mentions across the vault
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README emphasizes the database file stays readable plain Markdown without the plugin and that it never overwrites an existing file at the configured path.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a central list of people and consistently reference them by a stable key across notes.
summary: Contact database in a single Markdown table that lets you reference people anywhere with @mentions, autocomplete, hover cards, and vault-wide renames.
